author: zee
text:
Let me try. But I think you gave it all away a couple of posts back.
There is an IQM level. ITs will want to short there. They'll need the
buy orders. So, below their level there is a nice supply, so why not
make it work a bit ( you anticipated this, hence your trade ). Then
price goes back again, now we have a double top (well, almost), perfect
for stops above, just where they want them. So next push up won't hold,
and we'll have a BSZ trade, potentially with a bigger range fill down.
